com.trust.inference:mqttproxy:1.policyDescription: Publish inference results to IoT Core

Install.Script:
set -e
python3 -m venv '{work:path}/venv' || true
PY='{work:path}/venv/bin/python'
PIP='{work:path}/venv/bin/pip'
if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; PIP=pip; fi
$PY -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel
$PIP install numpy scipy boto3 awsiotsdk soundfile
$PIP install librosa==0.10.2 --no-deps || true
$PIP install audioread decorator joblib pooch scikit-learn resampy soxr typing_extensions lazy_loader msgpack || true
$PIP install tflite-runtime==2.14.0 || $PIP install --find-links https://google-coral.github.io/py-repo/ tflite_runtime || echo 'TFLite install failed, will use dummy mode'

Run.Script: PY='{work:path}/venv/bin/python'; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; fi; exec "$PY" -u {artifacts:path}/inference.py
